description: This file contains unit tests for the ModifyThingDefinition class in the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies immutability, JSON serialization, deserialization, and equality of the class.

classes.name: ModifyThingDefinitionTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the ModifyThingDefinition class, testing immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and object creation from JSON.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that instances of ModifyThingDefinition are immutable and that related classes are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals() and hashCode() methods using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that toJson() produces the expected JSON representation for a valid ModifyThingDefinition object.

methods.name: toJsonWithNullDefinitionReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that toJson() correctly serializes when the definition is null.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating an instance of ModifyThingDefinition from valid JSON input.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJsonWithNullDefinition
methods.description: Tests creating an instance from JSON with a null definition.
